verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents deploying or running the core Elastic Observability stack on your own infrastructure. The llms.txt line calling Elastic an "open source" platform and the "open by design" marketing claim do not document self-hosting. Running Elastic Agent or Fleet Server in a container covers data-collection components, not the core product, so it is adjacent only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
